jamie (eng-platform): Heads-up: customer hit an extra-charge case. streaming req fell back from eu-west -> us-east mid-stream, we retried and the toolcall got truncated on the original side. Ledger shows a provisional token for the truncated segment that never reconciled after the reconnect :grimacing: 

lina (billing): Ugh. Do we have the provisional vs confirmed lifecycle for that session? which service emitted the provisional event?

mike (runtime): I can see the session in traces. Router did a fallback with HTTP 502 -> re-created session id on the other side. The tail-side sent a truncated toolcall (tool TTL expired). Router emitted a `session_fallback` event.

billing-bot: PROVISIONAL_CHARGE logged: {session_id: "sess_78a", amount_tokens: 42, reason: "stream-truncate"} 

jamie (eng-platform): paste of small log chunk: 
```
[router] 2026-03-15T11:22:44Z session sess_78a: route eu-west -> us-east fallback(reason=connectivity)
[tail]   2026-03-15T11:22:44Z sess_78a.part: toolcall truncated ttl=0 trace_id=tr_9c
[ledger] 2026-03-15T11:22:45Z provisional_charge sess_78a part=3 tokens=42 src=router
[router] 2026-03-15T11:22:46Z new_session sess_78a.1 created on us-east
[tail]   2026-03-15T11:22:46Z sess_78a.1 resumed: final_ack missing
```

jamie (eng-platform): Note: `provisional_charge` came with src=router and no later confirm message. Customer sees a charge in console as final.

lina (billing): Current accounting model: ledger accepts provisional charges and awaits a `confirm_charge` from the tail. If no confirm within Xs we either auto-reverse or mark as final via reconciliation job. Looks like the confirm never arrived because the reconnect produced a new session id.

mike (runtime): Two possible fixes: (A) Router should carry an idempotency key tied to the original session + fallback counter so ledger can associate provisional->confirm across session renames. (B) Ledger should dedupe by (customer, request_signature, proxied_trace) heuristics. I lean to A — explicit idempotency is far clearer.

anya (devex-ux): From console perspective customers want to understand why a charge is "pending" vs "final". Can we show a reason string (e.g., "pending:router-fallback; truncated-toolcall") and a link to the trace? Right now it shows nothing. :eyes: 

lina (billing): We also need telemetry to be exact. Suggest adding `provisional_source` tag (router|tail|replay) and `provisional_key` that is the idempotency key the router would provide. That will let reconciliation find matches even if session ids changed.

mike (runtime): Implementation detail: router attach header `X-Redwood-Prov-Key: <session_root>:<fallback_n>` and include `original_trace_id`. Router + tail must forward that value on confirm. If tail cannot (TTL), ledger will hold provisional and later reconciler can match by key+trace.

jamie (eng-platform): Small compatibility note: some private deployments run an older router that won't emit this header. We need graceful fallbacks: ledger keeps old heuristics if header missing.

lina (billing): UX + backend tasks: 
- Backend: accept optional `prov_key` on provisional and confirm events, index it (lina) 
- Router/runtime: add prov_key header and propagate through handoff (mike) 
- Reconciler: attempt prov_key matching before heuristic (billing infra team) 
- Console: show provisional_reason and trace link, and mark whether reversed/pending/final (anya) 

anya (devex-ux): UI mock idea: show provisional pill with hover tooltip: "Pending confirmation (router fallback) — click to view trace". Also surface a small explain link in billing export. I'll mock in Figma. :art: 

mike (runtime): I'll prototype header in router this week. Quick patch: `prov_key = <root_session_id>|fb=<n>` and add to logs.

jamie (eng-platform): OK owners noted. Timeline? mike -> prototype by Thu, lina -> api index changes by next Tue, anya -> mock by Fri. Billing infra team: reconcile job rule change next sprint.

lina (billing): One more ask: emit a debug metric `provisional_unmatched_total` with labels {prov_source, region, model} so we can track regressions.

jamie (eng-platform): Agree. Also add a short runbook snippet: if `provisional_unmatched_total` spikes, check routing fallback graphs + failed confirms. I'll add to incidents/ runbook.

mike (runtime): cool. Will also include a small unit test that simulates fallback + toolcall ttl and asserts `prov_key` is preserved across confirm.

lina (billing): thanks. I'll patch ledger to prefer `prov_key` matching first. That should reduce customer-visible false-final charges.

anya (devex-ux): Filing a tiny docs blurb for billing FAQ once this lands.

jamie (eng-platform): Thanks everyone. Followups in PRs and link back here. :thumbsup:
